Shizuku or Sui lets PrismSpace use privileged system APIs to enhance cloning and cross-user operations.
Step 1 Start Shizuku, or install and enable Sui in a supported Root environment.
Step 2 For Shizuku, pair through Wireless debugging or start it with ADB/Root. Sui is detected automatically after it is enabled.
Step 3 Return here and tap below to check the transport and grant authorization when requested.
Check Shizuku / Sui

A dual-space manager for Android. Built on top of the system work profile, it provides isolated runtime environments so the same app can run with multiple accounts in parallel, with data fully separated.

Incomplete space detected

User %1$s has PrismSpace installed but was never fully set up. It takes up a system work profile slot and may have been created by an external tool. PrismSpace will not delete it automatically; you can remove it in system Settings.

Open system \"Settings - Accounts\", find the work profile that was not fully set up and select \"Remove work profile\". Settings may list several work profiles: do not remove the dual space you are using, or its clones and data will be deleted with it.
